# Frequently asked questions

## What does fak protect?

It protects **tool calls** and links to [the policy](https://example.com) while
preserving `snake_case` identifiers, *emphasis that wraps
across lines*, _underscored words_ and file_name_here intact.

## Background

This section is deliberately not a question and must not become FAQ schema.

## Can it run offline?

- Yes, the policy floor runs without a model key.
- 4x fewer tokens after **bold** stripping.

Too short.

## Doesn't it need a key

No: the deterministic demo runs with no key at all, really truly.

## Isé a word boundary

Python treats é as a word character so this heading is not a question lead.

## Who maintains it

```
fak run --offline
```
The maintainers listed in the repository, reviewed every release.

## WHAT about upper case

Upper-case leads still count as questions under the case-insensitive match.

## İs dotted capital I a lead

Python's case-insensitive match folds U+0130 onto i, so this is a question.

## ıs dotless small i a lead

Python's case-insensitive match folds U+0131 onto i, so this is a question.

## ſhould long s count

Python's case-insensitive match folds U+017F onto s, so this is a question.

## Known kelvin sign heading

No lead starts with k, so the Kelvin sign heading must stay out of the FAQ.
